namespace: kickside.work
entries:
- name: board
  kind: contract.definition
  meta:
    title: Work board
    comment: The board service - schema, items, reads and history. Every method runs under the caller's identity.
  methods:
  - name: create
    description: Create a board owned by the caller, optionally from a pack with starter items; requires Work administration and returns its board id and generation.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_081"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_082"}'
  - name: update
    description: Update board title, description or icon under board ADMIN; returns whether metadata changes and its command position, while the key prefix stays immutable.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_084"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_085"}'
  - name: list
    description: List boards readable by the caller; requires Work membership and returns board ids, titles, item counts and effective access.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_087"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_091"}'
  - name: get_schema
    description: Read the active or a past schema generation under board READ; returns its declaration, compiled model and plugin declarations.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_095"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_140"}'
  - name: plan_schema
    description: Plan a declaration change under board ADMIN without applying it; returns classifications, findings and migration requirements.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_142"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_146"}'
  - name: apply_schema
    description: Activate a declaration as the next schema generation under board ADMIN; returns the generation and migration state.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_148"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_149"}'
  - name: resume_migration
    description: Wake the board's parked follow migration so it continues from where it stopped. Needs ADMIN.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_150"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_151"}'
  - name: apply
    description: Apply item creates, edits, transitions, relations, comments, trash and restores under board WRITE and each operation's declared access; returns per-operation outcomes and command positions.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_156"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_160"}'
  - name: get
    description: Read an item by id or key under board READ and item visibility; returns its values and optional links, children, comments and transitions.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_163"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_187"}'
  - name: list_changes
    description: Read caller-visible item changes under board READ with a resumable sequence cursor; returns item updates, deletions and the projection position.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_191"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_200"}'
  - name: list_history
    description: Read board or item change history under board READ and item visibility; returns newest-first entries, an optional interval history and the next cursor.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_202"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_206"}'
  - name: get_time_in_state
    description: Read an item's recorded time in states, categories or interval-tracked fields under board READ; returns periods and duration totals.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_208"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_210"}'
  - name: query
    description: Find caller-visible items using filters, indexed ordering and cursors under board READ; returns an item page, optional groups and the projection position.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_226"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_235"}'
  - name: count
    description: Count caller-visible items matching a filter under board READ; returns the exact count through the declared cap and an estimate flag beyond it.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_237"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_238"}'
  - name: list_links
    description: List caller-visible links on a board, optionally for an item or target; requires board READ and returns a cursor page of relation endpoints.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_243"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_247"}'
  - name: list_comments
    description: List comments on a readable item; requires board READ and item visibility and returns comment bodies, authors and a page cursor.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_249"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_252"}'
  - name: list_stage_runs
    description: List stage attempts newest first under board READ and item visibility, with bounded keyset pages and recorded outputs and progress.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_249"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_253"}'
  - name: explain
    description: Explain the caller-visible query plan, indexes and access boundaries without returning item data; requires board READ.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_255"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_258"}'
  - name: configure_plugin
    description: Configure an active plugin attachment under board ADMIN; returns its attachment id and the position of the recorded configuration change.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_260"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_261"}'
  - name: approve
    description: Record an eligible approval or rejection for an item process visit under board WRITE; returns command outcomes and the resulting item version.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_263"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_160"}'
  - name: report
    description: Report an automated process attempt outcome under board WRITE; returns command outcomes after recording outputs and progressing the item.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_265"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_160"}'
  - name: bulk
    description: Start an asynchronous item update from a frozen query selection; requires board WRITE and returns its operation id, job and progress.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_272"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_273"}'
  - name: bulk_status
    description: 'Read the WorkBulk operation under board WRITE and operation-owner or ADMIN authority, returning status and progress counters.'
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_274"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_273"}'
  - name: cancel_bulk
    description: Cancel a bulk item update as a board writer; returns its current status and progress counters.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_274"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_273"}'
  - name: plan_move
    description: Plan moving an item subtree between boards with explicit type, state, field and relation mappings; requires source WRITE and DELETE plus target WRITE and returns findings and proposed items.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_278"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_285"}'
  - name: move
    description: Move an item subtree between boards using explicit mappings under source WRITE and DELETE plus target WRITE; returns the accepted operation and progress.
    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_278"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_273"}'
  - name: move_status

    input_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_286"}'
    output_schemas:
    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_273"}'

    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_287"}'
    output_schemas:

    - format: application/schema+json
      definition: '{"$work_ref": "schema_300"}'
